$comment: MCP text warning for a lexical-only search. The server (apps/server/src/mcp/tool-dispatch.ts) and kb mcp (apps/cli kb-local dispatch.rs) both read this file, so the two transports can't drift.
template: Warning: knowledge base {kbId} was searched lexical-only (keyword matching) because {why}.

why.NO_EMBEDDING_PROFILE: no embedding model is selected; choose one in the knowledge base settings for semantic search
why.EMBEDDING_PROFILE_REVOKED: its embedding provider was revoked; choose another in the knowledge base settings
why.SEMANTIC_INDEX_BUILDING: its semantic index is still building; semantic ranking starts when the build completes
why.default: its embedding model isn't available (disabled or not ready); check it in the knowledge base settings
